questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Biodiversity includes variation and relationships beyond species counts.
options: Biodiversity includes variation and relationships beyond species counts.
Equal species counts guarantee identical ecosystems.
Habitat connections have no conservation value.
A universal species list is sufficient for every protection plan.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Biodiversity includes variation and relationships beyond species counts.

source.en: Conservation decisions should therefore consider ecological relationships and local conditions instead of relying on species totals alone.
source.tr: Bu nedenle koruma kararları yalnızca toplam tür sayısına dayanmak yerine ekolojik ilişkileri ve yerel koşulları değerlendirmelidir.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: Equal species counts guarantee identical ecosystems.
options: Equal species counts guarantee identical ecosystems.
Two friends count the kinds of plants and animals they can see in a park.

Conservation decisions should therefore consider ecological relationships and local conditions instead of relying on species totals alone.
